description: This file defines a React component 'renderElement' that renders different types of document elements based on their 'type' property, including layout, heading, link, list, blockquote, relationship, divider, and default paragraph. It also includes helper components for code blocks and dividers, utilizing Slate.js and custom UI components.

methods.name: renderElement
methods.description: Main function that renders different document elements based on their type.

methods.name: CodeElement
methods.description: Renders a code block inside a pre and code tag.

methods.name: DividerElement
methods.description: Renders a divider with a styled horizontal rule, using Slate's useSelected hook to determine styling.
